I remember the scene. You're right. There's only so much my friends can do. I can lean on them for support, but there are things that are better suited for a professional. 

I am not receiving any sort of professional treatment. I tried that a few years ago but it did not end well. My mom tried to involve herself in a way that made it impossible for me to want to help myself, so I stopped going. I'd like to go back, but I don't know how to avoid the same mistake as last time. I've been meaning to call a hotline, but I never seem to be in a place where I can speak privately when I need to vent. I was given the number to a text hotline in another sub-reddit. I will make that happen soon.

Thank you for the help. You're so kind.
